prompt: Explain how REST API validation helps frontend dashboards handle bad input.
sources: Input validation rejects malformed payloads before database writes.
Consistent error responses let UI surfaces show actionable feedback.

response_a.text: REST API validation checks request fields before processing. Invalid payloads return structured errors so dashboards can show clear messages instead of silent failures.

response_b.text: Validation is optional and mainly used for styling forms. Databases always correct bad data automatically, so API checks are rarely needed.
